requirement: The system shall receive motion-tracking control input from external applications through OSC and expose the resulting virtual tracking state to SteamVR/OpenVR through a loadable VMT driver.
VMT Manager and VMT Driver shall exchange operational messages in both directions using JSON over shared memory.
For the supplied mycontroller legacy profile, right-hand inputs a, c, and b shall trigger the OpenVR legacy axis-1 press, A-button press, and grip-press actions, respectively.
